comparisons.peer_topic: Customer Concentration and Key Customer Risk
comparisons.peer_summary: Direct sales to a single distributor accounted for 28% and 21% of net revenue in fiscal years 2024 and 2023, with top five end customers representing approximately 40% and 35% respectively. The company expects significant customer concentration to continue and warns that loss of these customers could materially adversely affect business results.
comparisons.comparison: Both NVDA and AVGO disclose customer concentration metrics, though NVDA focuses on geographic revenue distribution while AVGO focuses on customer count and specific large accounts. NVDA reports that revenue from outside the United States accounted for 56% of total revenue in fiscal year 2024, designating geography by billing location. AVGO similarly highlights that a small number of customers account for significant portions of net revenue, with direct sales to a single distributor accounting for 28% of net revenue in fiscal year 2024, and the top five end customers representing approximately 40% of net revenue. While NVDA's disclosure addresses geographic exposure, AVGO's addresses counterparty risk, both serving as key revenue concentration disclosures within Item 7.

sentences.text: Revenue from sales to customers outside of the United States accounted for 56% and 69% of total revenue for fiscal years 2024 and 2023, respectively.
We believe aggregate sales to our top five end customers, through all channels, accounted for approximately 40% and 35% of our net revenue for fiscal years 2024 and 2023, respectively.
Direct sales to one customer, which is a distributor, accounted for 28% and 21% of our net revenue for fiscal years 2024 and 2023, respectively.
